facts.summary: FDA issued Complete Response Letter, finding insufficient evidence of effectiveness · Filed (BLA resubmission) · Deramiocel in Duchenne muscular dystrophy · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The CRL states that the FDA does not consider the data sufficient to establish substantial evidence of effectiveness and cites certain other clinical deficiencies.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Deramiocel has been studied in two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials, HOPE-2 and HOPE-3, both of which met their primary endpoints.
